articles.title: A small bulletin to take with you
articles.body:
This is a fictional community bulletin. All places, events and opening times in this example are made up.

Aftertext brings back teletext: a page number, a few lines, and the information you came for.

Choose a notice from the index or type its three-digit number. Long notices have subpages.

Use Edit bulletin to make your own. Export the file, pass it on, and open it on another device. Once the app is available offline, you can keep reading without a connection.

articles.title: Book swap: bring a favourite
articles.body:
The book swap is now in the reading room.

Bring a book you would like someone else to find. Leave it on the blue shelf and choose a different one to take home.

Books in every language are welcome: 한글, 日本語, café.

Please keep the doorway clear. Large boxes can wait on the table by the window.

The next swap is Saturday, 10:00 to 12:00. This is a fictional notice for the demo.

Want to leave a note inside your book? A few words about why you liked it are enough.

  Original spaces stay in the exported file.

articles.title: Repair morning
articles.body:
EXAMPLE NOTICE

A loose button, a wobbly chair, a favourite toy with a missing wheel. Bring something small to the repair table.

In this fictional notice:
Sunday, 8 November
11:00 to 14:00
The old school room

Bring any spare parts you already have. Repairs depend on the tools and people available that morning. No booking is needed.

articles.title: Reading room hours
articles.body:
EXAMPLE OPENING TIMES

Monday      10:00–16:00
Tuesday     10:00–16:00
Wednesday   Closed
Thursday    10:00–18:00
Friday      10:00–16:00
Saturday    09:00–12:00
Sunday      Closed

These times describe an invented reading room. Replace them with checked local information before sharing a bulletin of your own.

articles.title: From a few words to a whole channel
articles.body:
Open Edit bulletin and choose a notice. Give it a three-digit page number, a topic and a title. Write the information people need.

Set an issue date so readers can judge whether the information is still current. Add a source link if there is one.

Save bulletin keeps your changes on this device when storage is available. Export file downloads the portable bulletin. Open file reads one someone has shared with you.

The page view wraps the text into 40 columns. Reading view uses larger, naturally wrapping text. Both show the same notice.

The file is plain text data. It contains no photos, accounts or tracking code. Share only information you are entitled to publish.
